# plug

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/internal/kit/plug"
```

Package plug is where kit's opt-in subsystems plug in: the HTTP engine and the frontends' file server (framework/kit/server), the Studio's event stream and its profiler (framework/kit/studio). kit reads what they registered through the hooks declared here, and imports none of the SDK packages behind them: a product that does not import a subsystem neither links nor initialises its packages.

The package imports the standard library and the framework's model only, so that kit and every subsystem can import it.

## type [EventStream](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/framework/internal/kit/plug/decl_gen.go>)

EventStream is one Server-Sent Events stream: the Studio's live events.

```go
type EventStream interface {
	// Close ends the stream.
	Close() error
	// Done is closed when the client left.
	Done() <-chan struct{}
	// Send writes one event's data.
	Send(data string) error
}
```

<a name="HTTPConfig"></a>
## type [HTTPConfig](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/framework/internal/kit/plug/decl_gen.go>)

HTTPConfig is what kit asks of the HTTP engine: where to listen, its one socket, its bounds, and the handler.

```go
type HTTPConfig struct {
	// Addr is where to listen, "host:port".
	Addr           string
	// Shards is how many sockets the engine opens on Addr.
	Shards         int
	// ReadHeader, Read, Write and Idle bound a request's phases.
	ReadHeader     time.Duration
	// ReadHeader, Read, Write and Idle bound a request's phases.
	Read           time.Duration
	// ReadHeader, Read, Write and Idle bound a request's phases.
	Write          time.Duration
	// ReadHeader, Read, Write and Idle bound a request's phases.
	Idle           time.Duration
	// MaxHeaderBytes bounds a request's header.
	MaxHeaderBytes int
	// Handler answers every request.
	Handler        http.Handler
}
```

## type [HTTPServer](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/framework/internal/kit/plug/decl_gen.go>)

HTTPServer is the HTTP engine kit starts, reads and stops.

```go
type HTTPServer interface {
	// Shutdown drains the engine within ctx.
	Shutdown(ctx context.Context) error
	// Start binds the address and serves, returning once bound.
	Start(ctx context.Context) error
	// State says what the engine binds and serves.
	State() HTTPState
}
```

<a name="HTTPState"></a>
## type [HTTPState](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/framework/internal/kit/plug/decl_gen.go>)

HTTPState is what the HTTP engine says of itself once it runs: the address it bound, and its connections.

```go
type HTTPState struct {
	// Addr is the address the engine bound, "" before it did.
	Addr      string
	// Listeners is how many sockets it listens on.
	Listeners int
	// Active are the connections being served, Total those accepted since
	// the start, Rejected those refused.
	Active    int64
	Total     uint64
	Rejected  uint64
}
```

<a name="ProfilerConfig"></a>
## type [ProfilerConfig](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/framework/internal/kit/plug/decl_gen.go>)

ProfilerConfig is the Studio's profiler: the live heap folded onto the graph's nodes, and every goroutine grouped.

```go
type ProfilerConfig struct {
	// Heap folds the live heap onto g's nodes; source says where a function
	// of a module lies, nil when it knows none.
	Heap       func(g *model.Graph, source SourceFunc) (*model.Profile, error)
	// Goroutines groups every goroutine of the process, read at at.
	Goroutines func(at time.Time) (*model.Goroutines, error)
}
```
